description: This is a localization script defining Finnish (Finland) culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same timestamp.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date is equal to another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week based on the name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on the name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a specific year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation for a specific offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a timezone name.
